implemented.extremeDamage: blunt max weapon + max DB; impaling max weapon + DB + another weapon die; computed in pure code because the compat Roll ignores maximize

implemented.closeCombat: dodge tie -> defender; fight back needs a strictly higher band and deals regular damage only
